description: Canonical fixed source registry for the Nottinghamshire Jobs Workflow-First weekly update.

sources.name: Nottinghamshire TAL
sources.fallback: If the fixed board is blocked, use fresh exact-domain indexing restricted to nottinghamshire.tal.net to locate the current brand-8 board. Preserve and follow current source-exposed /opp/<id>-.../ links.
notes: The xf-... path segment is dynamic and is not part of the board identity.
A school or trust vacancy from this source can classify as Education rather than Council.

sources.name: Nottingham City Council
sources.fallback: Use rendered/current results from the fixed Oracle site when static extraction is incomplete. The public requisition endpoint is optional and is not required to establish weekly success.

sources.name: Ashfield District Council
sources.fallback: Use rendered access or fresh exact-domain indexing of this known portal when simple retrieval returns 403. Capture current vacancy IDs or individual links; do not guess them.

sources.name: Mansfield District Council
sources.fallback: Use this exact WVID and rendered/current results when simple retrieval returns 403. Do not mix Mansfield and Ashfield results.

sources.name: Bassetlaw District Council
sources.fallback: Use rendered access or fresh exact-domain indexing of the fixed board when needed.

sources.name: Newark & Sherwood District Council
sources.fallback: Use rendered/current board or fresh exact-domain indexing. Capture the real current vacancy ID or link rather than guessing.

sources.name: Gedling Borough Council
sources.fallback: Process every visible current vacancy and follow the job-specific links.

sources.name: Broxtowe Borough Council
sources.fallback: Process the list and follow each qualifying vacancy link.

sources.name: Rushcliffe Borough Council
sources.fallback: Process the list and click through to each qualifying advert.

sources.name: Nottingham University Hospitals
sources.fallback: Collect the current employer jobs, filter to Nottinghamshire candidates, then finish the individual adverts before moving on.

sources.name: Nottinghamshire Healthcare
sources.fallback: Filter by actual Nottinghamshire work base because some Trust jobs are outside Nottinghamshire, then finish qualifying individual adverts.

sources.name: Sherwood Forest Hospitals
sources.fallback: Verify the actual Nottinghamshire base, current status and any stated deadline, then finish each qualifying individual advert.

sources.name: University of Nottingham
sources.fallback: Always start from the exact cat=-1 full current-opportunities route. Capture current rows and individual links, exclude obvious Internal Only, China/Ningbo, studentships or non-Nottinghamshire roles, and finish every qualifying advert.

sources.name: Nottingham Trent University
sources.fallback: Use the rendered/current list and normal Load More or page sequence. Static zero is not authoritative. Capture and follow current Jobtrain IDs or links before closing the source.

sources.name: Nottingham College
sources.fallback: Follow and finish qualifying individual adverts. Do not confuse college employment with external apprenticeships advertised to learners.

sources.name: West Nottinghamshire College
sources.fallback: Use rendered/current board or fresh exact-domain indexing when simple retrieval returns 403. Capture the actual current individual vacancy ID or link rather than guessing.

sources.name: North Notts College / RNN Group
sources.fallback: Include Nottinghamshire bases such as Worksop or North Notts and exclude Rotherham or other out-of-county bases.

sources.name: GOV.UK Teaching Vacancies
sources.fallback: Increment only page= through visible results, check the actual school address and finish each qualifying individual advert.

sources.name: Nottingham CVS
sources.fallback: Try the fixed page first; if unavailable, use a fresh indexed copy of that exact page and follow current vacancy or employer links. Include paid in-scope VCSE roles with a Nottinghamshire base while live.
